    "Model forecasts consistently undershoot true prices by 0.5-1.0 on early days, correcting within 3-5 days",
    "Price divergence accelerates after day 10 as model fails to capture sustained price momentum",
    "Sentiment positive (≥0.67) fails to predict corresponding price increases, especially after day 15",
    "Model exhibits mean-reversion bias at extremes, underpredicting continuations by 2-4 on days 11-20",
    "When sentiment flips from positive to negative, model lags by 2-3 days with values still trending up",
    "Price levels below 63 show strongest forecast errors as model was trained on higher range",
    "Sentiment neutrality (0.33-0.67) correlates poorly with flat prices, creating 1-2 daily error bands"
  ]
